changeSet.author: taurus
changeSet.comment: Rebuilds the origin of the reminders created before the column existed, in the order of precedence of the lead time: the value chosen on the occurrence, then the one of the event, then the profile default, then the application default. Without this the rescheduling of a profile default would rebuild jobs that carry a lead time somebody chose by hand.

changeSet.author: taurus
changeSet.comment: Closes the pending reminders that are already past: the event has begun, or the send instant is more than a day old and the start is unknown. Left pending they would be delivered late at the first run.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE push_reminders SET status = 'SKIPPED', skip_reason = 'EVENT_STARTED', next_attempt_at = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND event_start_at IS NOT NULL AND event_start_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
UPDATE push_reminders SET status = 'SKIPPED', skip_reason = 'STALE', next_attempt_at = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND event_start_at IS NULL AND send_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 day';

changeSet.author: taurus
changeSet.comment: Rebuilds on the status the two indexes that stood on the sent boolean, the unique one included: it is what keeps a single pending reminder per event and member.

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS uq_push_reminder_pending_event_user; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_push_reminders_status_send_at;

changeSet.author: taurus
changeSet.comment: Drops the sent boolean: the status of the job is the only truth, and two flags could disagree.

changeSet.author: taurus
changeSet.comment: Soft deletes the copies of the legacy defaultReminderMinutes preference: the value lives in the notification profile, and nothing reads the key any more. The rows stay readable for a while instead of disappearing.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE preferences SET deleted = TRUE, edit_by = 'notification-preferences-contract', edit_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE key = 'defaultReminderMinutes' AND deleted = FALSE;
